name: design-visual-qa
description: Audit implemented UI visually using screenshots or renders, identify mismatches, prioritize fixes, and repeat verification.
user-invocable: true
---
# Visual QA

Compare intended design vs rendered result. Check composition, alignment, spacing, typography, color, states, responsiveness, motion, overflow, and accessibility.

## Loop
CAPTURE -> OBSERVE -> IDENTIFY -> PRIORITIZE -> PATCH -> CAPTURE AGAIN.

Never claim a screenshot or test was performed when the tooling was unavailable.
